title: add vpc control plane terraform: multi-az subnets, interface endpoints, sgs, peering, route53
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: enable private control plane installations to be provisioned in customer VPCs across multiple AZs with support for interface endpoints, security groups, cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation. This change adds a reusable Terraform module and Helm chart tweaks to the private-installer to support multi-AZ subnets, optional interface endpoints (s3, sts, secretsmanager), security group templates, cross-account VPC peering with route propagation, and Route53 inbound/outbound delegation for control-plane DNS. Changes include backward-compatible defaults and a migration guide. Checklist: 1) Add Terraform module with inputs for az_count, subnet_cidrs, endpoint flags, and peering config. 2) Add templates for security groups and IAM role trust updates for peering. 3) Add upgrade hooks and rollback plan to the installer for existing single-AZ deployments. 4) Add unit tests for TF plan + integration verification steps. 5) Update Helm values to surface endpoint toggles. Notes: This is a production-sensitive infra PR, reviewed with networking and security teams; it includes documented manual verification steps and an automated plan that can be run against a test account.

release_notes: Added terraform module 'vpc-control-plane' to provision multi-AZ subnets, interface endpoints, security groups, optional cross-account peering, and Route53 private hosted zone delegation. Exposes helm values to toggle endpoints and SG overrides. Migration guide included for existing single-AZ installations.
verification_steps: Run 'terraform init && terraform plan' against staging account using example overlay
Deploy private-installer to test cluster with new helm values and confirm installer successfully provisions control plane resources
Verify interface endpoints (s3, sts, secretsmanager) are created only when enabled
Confirm Route53 delegation records created and DNS resolution from peered VPC resolves control plane endpoints
Run smoke test: create control plane component and ensure TLS and API connectivity over peering link
backout_plan: If deployment causes unexpected network problems, run installer rollback script 'installer/rollback/rollback-peering.sh' to remove peering and route modifications, revert the terraform state to previous version from remote state snapshot, and redeploy previous helm chart release. Notify networking and security oncall and open incident if DNS or API is degraded.
